faits.fait: Almerys manages third-party payment (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly) on behalf of supplementary insurers: insurance companies, supplementary health insurers (mutuelles) and social protection groups.

Almerys is an operator, not a care network. A supplementary health insurer can pair it with a separate network: Aéma Groupe chose Almerys for the third-party payment of its insurers (Aésio mutuelle, Apivia Macif Mutuelle, MNFCT, Math - Prevaris) and Carte Blanche Partenaires as its care network.
To get a network agreement, the optician sends a voided claim form or their local health insurance office (CPAM) certificate to the Almerys network agreement unit.
To access the professional portal, you must be under agreement with Almerys and have validated your account following the instructions Almerys sends.
Coverage requests are made on the Almerys “Site des PEC” (coverage request site), with a username and password.
Each store logs in with its username and password, then enters a 6-digit one-time code sent by email at every login.
An optical request can be a quote or a coverage request. The “Valoriser” (Price) button creates the request: a coverage approval (PEC) number is assigned and the amounts are displayed.
Each item is entered by its LPP code. For lenses, it is the supplier’s code. A request covers only one piece of equipment: a second piece of equipment needs a second request.
The online professional portal is reopening gradually. Each professional receives an email titled “Réouverture site en ligne Almerys” (Almerys online site reopening) before they can log in.
Almerys does not handle complaints from insured people. They should be directed to their supplementary insurer, whose name appears on the third-party payment card.
In early 2020, the Rof (a French opticians’ union) issued a formal notice contesting Almerys’s requirement to receive the signed quote and the prescription for coverage requests.

conventionnement: Send a voided claim form or the CPAM certificate to celluleconventionnementalmerys@almerys.com.
Wait for the email from Almerys with the instructions to validate your account.
